Package edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.shapefile

package edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.shapefile
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    edu.cnu.mdi.mapping
     
  • Class
    Description
    ShapeFeature
    Immutable representation of a single feature loaded from an arbitrary ESRI Shapefile — a geometry (polygon rings, polyline parts, or points) paired with an open-ended property bag drawn from the companion .dbf table.
    ShapeFeatureRenderer
    Renders a list of ShapeFeature instances onto an IContainer using a supplied IMapProjection and ShapeFeatureStyle, and supports mouse-over hit testing via IPickable.
    ShapeFeatureStyle
    Configures the visual appearance of a ShapeFeatureRenderer layer.
    ShapefileCrsValidator
    Validates that shapefile coordinates can safely be interpreted as WGS84 longitude and latitude in decimal degrees.
    ShapefileDbfReader
    Zero-dependency reader for dBASE III (.dbf) attribute tables as used in ESRI Shapefiles.
    ShapefileDbfReader.FieldDescriptor
    Immutable description of a single .dbf field (column).
    ShapefileFeatureLoader
    Loads arbitrary ESRI Shapefile data into ShapeFeature instances without any assumptions about the attribute schema or geometry type.
    ShapefileGeometryReader
    Zero-dependency reader for the binary geometry data in ESRI Shapefile (.shp) files.
    ShapefileGeometryReader.ShapeRecord
    Immutable container for the geometry data of a single shapefile record.
    ShapefileMenu
    A JMenu that provides interactive shapefile loading and per-layer visibility control for a MapView2D.
